name: Sam Rivera
subtitle: Home is something we make
intro: Recipes with no exact measurements, friends in several cities, and a table that travels from home to home.
description: A fictional adult life still unfolding, collected through food, moves, friendship, and the small work of belonging somewhere.
heroAlt: A golden loaf on a white cloth beside butter and a knife
heroCaption: An illustrative photograph. Sam and every memory in this collection are fictional.
quote: Start with the onions. Somebody will arrive.
quoteAttribution: A saying from Sam’s fictional kitchen
